reviews.name: Trinh Peak Consulting
reviews.text:
I know how stressful it is when your animal needs care, so I feel obligated to share what happened to me in the hope that others can avoid the same ordeal. This is my own experience as a client here, and it came down to three things: prepaid services I never received, repeated billing errors on my account, and a near-total inability to reach anyone who could help.

The prepaid plan I purchased. I bought their "Kitty Premium" plan that was offered to my 9-months old kitty, which included a second appointment. I was never given that appointment, and I have not been refunded for the unused portion of what I paid.

What happened with my billing. I was double-charged. The front desk staff told me the account manager would sort it out, but the account manager never returned my calls or texts. After weeks of back-and-forth with nothing resolved, I ended up opening a dispute through my bank to get the charge corrected. When someone from their team finally did respond to me, the figures they gave me were wrong. And they finally make the correct refund.

Where it went after my dispute. Once the bank resolved the charge and paid them the correct package amount, I was still not given the second appointment I had already paid for. That left me opening a second dispute simply to recover money for a service I never received. I am still in an unresolved back-and-forth with them over it.

My experience trying to reach them. Getting hold of anyone with actual authority was, for me, extremely difficult. My calls and emails rarely got a response. Their text line is staffed by an outsourced help desk that could book appointments but told me it had no access to billing or account information, so every attempt I made to resolve the double-charge stalled there. Messages I asked to have passed to the account manager went unanswered. The only thing that ever got me a reply was a credit card dispute -- and even my own bank had difficulty reaching them. Being routed to a channel that could not help me, with no path to someone who could, turned what should have been a simple billing correction into weeks of wasted effort.

Where I stand now. I have emailed their office a document titled "Settlement Proposal: Dispute Resolution & Refund Request for Kitty Premium Package," laying out a clear path to settle the balance and part ways. I will keep this review updated as things progress, and I will revise it if and when the matter is resolved.

Bottom line: Based on my own experience, I would not recommend this practice. Save yourself the trouble and take your pet elsewhere.

We brought our cat in for international travel health certificate, and it was an absolute nightmare due to repeated Negligence from the Technician, ended up wasting 2wks of our vacation time & >$1k to change flights.

Negligence 1: wrong microchip# on Titer test paperwork submission

The technician named Jessica recorded our cat’s microchip# wrong with 1 more digit, so titer test shows wrong chip# as well . The USDA caught the error and rejected health certificate issuance. What’s more frustrating was, when the mistake was caught, Jessica didn’t acknowledge her negligence and tried to blame us for the wrong chip# (which was later proven not the case).

To make the experience worse: even the vet paid for correcting the paperwork, but the technician failed to properly communicate with rabies lab for expediting correction. They said they called the lab everyday, but after 4 days of nothing, we missed our flight, then we decided to call the rabies lab ourselves. Upon lab staff being explained on the urgency, the staff was nice enough to re-issue the corrected report on the same day we reached out. So we are not sure what the heck did the technician say when they called the lab “everyday”.

Negligence 2: forgot to renew exam date on health certificate application

Since cat physical exam is valid only for 2wks for the country we were traveling to, and due to the titer test report error drama wasted 1 wk, we had to take our cat in for the 2nd time to re-establish new exam date.
When the technician resubmitted the health certificate, the technician made another error by putting on the old (1st) exam date. So by the time we received the health certificate, it’s already past the last day of validation. Needless to say, we missed our flight again due to this.

We feel sorry for the vet, Dr. Salwan, as he seems to be a decent and reasonable person, throughout the whole process, he tried hard to correct & own up to their mistakes. But it was clear that the technician at Tricity is lack of training, attention to details and accountability.

It was a huge waste of time and money for us, I wouldn’t recommend this place to anyone needing travel documents or important tests for their pets.

reviews.text:
Please be careful before you consider taking your vet here. The quality of care has significantly declined over the years. Be very mindful as we dealt with multiple issues from "system glitch" for billing error to lack of professionalism from staff. We used to think we could trust their transparency/billing but we cannot. I don't want another pet owner to make a decision based on the quote/credit the staff acknowledges, and then have to pay a large bill they weren't expecting due to a "glitch in the system".

As a concerned pet owner, I feel obligated to share my experience to help ensure others do not face similar experiences.

Issue 1: Billing and Record Keeping Errors
We contacted Tricity Veterinary Hospital to schedule a routine dental cleaning for our first dog. The receptionist informed us there was a credit of $519.17 on file, which had been noted by the bookkeeper. After asking them to verify the credit, they confirmed it was due to an overpayment, so we scheduled a cleaning for our second dog as well. The appointment was set for October 17.

On October 20, we were contacted and told there had been a record-keeping error, and that we owed $519.17. We explained that we wouldn’t have scheduled the second cleaning had the credit not been available. Prior to the appointment we had multiple requests for confirmation &  staff continued say that the credit was from an overpayment. Then they kept pushing us to pay the difference, blaming the issue on a "system glitch." Never taking slight ownership. We never solicited this “credit” they were the ones that informed us of it.
We had an invoice for services totaling $699.50, with the noted credit. It is concerning that this error might not be isolated, potentially affecting other customers. It’s critical that Tricity Veterinary Hospital reviews its billing practices to prevent other pet owners from relying on inaccurate information and facing unexpected charges due to "record-keeping errors."

Issue 2: Dog Mix Up for Medication Inquiry
The second issue involved a call from staff notifying us that our dogs were denied the Sentinel Spectrum flea and heartworm prevention medication due to a history of seizures, which our dogs do not have. When we asked the administrator to double-check, she refused to do so at first and continued explaining, claiming the denial was based on our dogs' history. Only after we insisted did she review the records and realize she had confused our dogs with another pet. This lack of attention to detail is deeply troubling and raises concerns about the reliability of their medical records.

Issue 3: Lack of Accountability from Dr. Shiv Salwan.When we asked the staff and bookkeeping team to take responsibility for the billing error, they refused and pressured us to resolve the issue by making the payment. We requested a call from Dr. Shiv Salwan, hoping for understanding and resolution. However, Dr. Shiv did not apologize. He explained that another dog with the same name as ours was mistakenly linked to our account but continued to insist that we were legally liable to pay the full amount for the second cleaning.Dr. Shiv also used the example, “If the bank deposited $10,000 in your account, would you question it?” We responded that we had already asked his staff several times to verify the credit and check the records, trusting that their records were accurate. At that point, we had done all we could as clients. Dr. Shiv remained dismissive, suggesting we should have done more, and continued to push us to resolve the matter without taking responsibility for the mistake.  In the end, Dr. Shiv suggested that we "go our separate ways."

We are deeply disappointed with this experience. What was once a well-run veterinary hospital now displays a lack of professionalism, accountability, and care for its clients. I worry that other pet owners may face similar issues without proper resolution.

reviews.text:
I want to start by saying that I had high hopes for this vet, but was beyond disappointed and I’m looking into legal options based on this experience. If you want the full story, read the entire review here.

My pup was experiencing some orthopedic issues, likely related to a previous surgery (not done by this vet), and I was having trouble finding a vet in the area that could see her quickly. They were able to see her same day when most vets were booked a couple weeks out - in hindsight, perhaps this was a red flag instead of a whisper of hope.

I arrived at 11:25a for my 11:30a appointment. Three employees behind the desk, but not a glance or a welcome. No worries. I stood there, patiently, for 10 minutes until someone asked me what I needed.

I met with the vet, he suggested x-rays, I understood and signed off. He said her injury was in or around the knee, but wouldn’t know more until scans were done. We opted to do them same day and would pick her up later. They took her back to start the prep, and I asked if I could see her before she was sedated (you never know). They agreed, told me to wait out front, but came back a few minutes later and said it was too late and I couldn’t see her. I wasn’t allowed to go back and she couldn’t be brought up front.

We were told that they’d call us when she could be picked up, likely around 5p (7p closing). At 6:30p, no call. So we called, and they say, “yes, she’s ready for pickup.” Of course she is. It was probably hours ago. The following evening, we get a call from an employee to go over the results. We’re told that there’s *nothing* they can do, and that “in the meantime” we should make her “comfortable” with “pain management, weight reduction, and reduced activity.” This is a young, active dog with an orthopedic injury - does this language seem appropriate? These are phrases you use for terminal patients.

I had many questions, in terms of next steps, what the specific injury was, what we should do… “I’ll have to follow up with the doctor.” No prognosis, no forward thinking, no recommendations. I asked if I could sit down or speak with the vet on the phone, and I was told, “that’s not possible, he’s very busy, but you can book another exam and bring her back in.” At this point, I haven’t seen the scans, I haven’t spoken with a doctor, but I’m being told my dog can take drugs and lay down moving forward. I asked what the actual diagnosis was, and I was told, explicitly, “that her bones are all out of normal position, and the hip is nothing like he’s ever seen before” and that “surgery is not an option.” We cried the rest of the night.

Over the next week or so, I fought with them to get her records and her images. We’re now two weeks out and I STILL do not have the scans, just pictures of the pictures, despite repeated requests. I ended up bringing her to another vet, had to pay for additional x-rays (because the previous ones weren’t taken with her hips in the right position and were paper copies, difficult to use) and put her through another round of sedatives and physical exam.

I spent 1.5+ hours with this new vet, getting x-rays done and reviewing immediately after (all at one appointment), received an actual prognosis, multiple recommendations, and formed a plan. The experience was night and day, and I’m absolutely furious that I gave this Tricity a single dollar. I’ve already contacted a lawyer to discuss options, as nobody should ever have to be put through an experience like this again. I’m sure this vet can handle tummy aches and vaccines, but I would never recommend you bring an animal with a serious issue. From the moment they saw my pup, or at least after x-rays, they should have said that they weren’t capable of assisting, and that surgery wasn’t something *THEY* could do, based on their expertise and the specific issue at hand.
Oh, here comes the best part - the new vet did the physical exam with me (unlike Tricity, who took her from me), and walked me through each step, including findings. Turns out the knee is fine, as is the alignment of bones.

reviews.name: K. P.
reviews.text: One of the best veterinary hospitals in the bay. They are always available and I’ve had two German Shepherds cared for by them. They can handle them easily. The staff is great and so are the Vets! Try them and you’ll agree.

reviews.name: Jeff Yu
reviews.text: Wow it helps my dog in every way

reviews.name: Yi-Chun Chen
reviews.text:
First of all, the waiting time in the front area is extremely long. Even you arrive within the assigned time frame, the receptionist takes care of you probably 20min later or more.
Secondly, after talking to the vet or the nurse about pet's condition, they take pets to the back of the hospital. You don't know what they are doing to your pet in the back. The process of examination and treatment is not transparent, you never know if it's the professionals who's doing the job. I say this because our cat had suffered from their careless job.
My cat had a surgery from this hospital and the technician accidentally removed all his stitches after two days from the surgery. And of course the cut from the surgery was wide-opened like an open zipper, we can easily see our cat's bloody flesh from this wound. We told the vet about it early next day, and they asked us to bring him back to the hospital. My cat was suffering from anesthesia and re-stitch AGAIN. The ironic thing is that they didn't apologize about it, and even said they don't charge for this anesthesia or stitch. I was jaw-dropping when hearing this.
By the way, there's a miscommunication between the vet, nurses and front receptionist, the receptionist/nurses might not be able to answer all the questions about the pet's status or explain well the instructions of the medicine.
I really truly hope they can view our pets like our human babies, they are unique family members to us! Pets' life matters!
(I noticed they have a lot of 5 stars reviews recently, and most of them are from accounts rarely used. The content of the reviews are pretty similar. I'll leave it to you to tell if those reviews are real or not. )

reviews.name: Suramya Naik
reviews.text: Dr. Raj is a great doctor. Clearly explained issues with my cat, helped me with a plan that works for us financially as well. My cat is healthy and Happy.. thank you Dr Raj and Tricity Veterinary Hospital.

reviews.name: Mary N
reviews.text: I highly recommend Dr. Raj . My 11 pound maltipoo  was treated by him for a dental cleaning  under anesthesia today . I was a little nervous for my dog because it was his first time having a major procedure like this . I was surprised how well it went  as he had a lot of tarter build up . Dr. Raj did a great job removing it. His teeth are now pearly white just like it was when he was a baby. Affordable care and excellent service.

reviews.name: D Jackson
reviews.text:
I went in on February 3, 2023 for one of my furbabies was limping and needed her flea and heartguard medicine prescription renewed. My daughter recommended this place.

My furbaby had a couple of injections one antibiotics and one for her pain. She was prescribed pain and antibiotics for home treatment.

When we were checking out the receptionist made a comment of she has fleas. I guess from the back they told her to tell me. We never got the flea or heartguard prescription renewed.  It should not take this long or be this hard to renew a prescription.

Now I have to get her seen at her again at her regular veterinarian and pay for another visit. Not to mentioned that I took a day off from work to be seen that day.

I would have given them one star. My girl is better but not all of the services I asked for.

reviews.name: Byron
reviews.text: The staff was friendly and the Dr was professional and it didn't cost me an arm and a leg., and offered a payment plan if I couldn't  pay entire amount due. It says alot about the Dr. Thank you staff ,for taking care of Oreo !

reviews.name: Tina Khum
reviews.text: Nice place, good people, very good doctor and very good price too.

reviews.name: Lawrence Liang
reviews.text:
I had a cat go in to be fixed couple months ago, and the wounds opens up again after 2 weeks.

Talking with my neighbor this happened to another her cat there too.  Had another neighbor who lost his dog due to lack of care there.

The story is that the older father is retiring, and the son is slowly taking over, and is still in vet school, and is doing the surgery. Maybe there's a reason they don't even have a Yelp page.

This is really a place to avoid. By
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
All surgeries are done by our Veterinarians and not “students.” We have performed 10s of thousands of these surgeries without incident, and we do more surgeries than most local veterinary hospitals.
Most common complications are due to aftercare at home…either the pet is too active or the cone gets taken off and pet licks or pet scratches at the incision. The incision doesn’t just open up as sutures are used.  If you have any further concerns, please call us as we would love to help you.

reviews.name: Travis Bentz
reviews.text: Tricity was OK enough as my closest vet office.  I was running late for my pup's teeth cleaning, showing up exactly ten minutes after my scheduled appt time.  Waited inside for a little over 20 minutes (with a broken security system constantly beeping) to be told that I was too late for my appt and needed to reschedule.  My dog has been fasting for 12 hours, I've been patiently waiting for 20 minutes, and because of this <1 minute discrepancy of my check-in time, the full day appointment is cancelled?  Tricity was apparently done with me as a customer and I am in turn, done with them as a vet.  I encourage others to avoid this place.

reviews.name: sara perez
reviews.text:
IF YOU LOVE YOUR DOG, FOR THE LOVE OF ALL GOOD THINGS PLEASE DO NOT TAKE THEM TO THIS HOSPITAL, Especially if you don’t wanna be RIPPED OFF. I Repeat PLS DO NOT BRING YOUR LOVED ONES HERE!!!
Brought my 12 year old pitty for the first time on Friday morning, he had been vomiting and lost his appetite. The night before I decided to take him in his bladder became uncontrollable.
Once at the appt. They came and took Tyga to the back for “examination” which I did not see, if you like to be apart of this process then DON’T BRING THEM HERE, after they took him I was unable to see him before I left the facility.
A few mins later the vet came back saying his badder looked a little bloated, and that he needed X-rays and blood work, also Urine test not one but two types the second one being 300$ Which I agreed to immediately because I wanted a through check up on him, the vet even made it a point to charge me to clip his nails, when I got the dog back they didn’t even bother to touch them but we’re quick to charge for the service, at that point I already knew the bill was gonna be very high, mind you I might have spoke to the vet for about 5 mins before he was gone and never saw him again. My bill was over 1000$, they had given me meds Tyga did not require in reality we needed antibiotics which I tried to ask for but couldn’t speak to the vet directly after picking up Tyga in the after noon, on a STRETCHER, they charged me for a fecal matter test they never did this is on top of there false advertising about you’re first time patient deal being 15.99 on there website, I paid 40$ for the consultation. This place was very disorganized and by no means was it a clean facility, I should have seen all the red flags 🚩 but I just wanted Tyga to be treated ASAP. It is now Monday we were told we’d receive his x-ray results by Saturday, we missed the call and when we called back the technician had already left and no one could give us answers, we called yesterday and also no one could give us answers, We thought Monday morning would be easier.

reviews.name: Casey Powell
reviews.text: Everyone at this clinic is friendly and knowledgeable, and they will make you and your pet feel comfortable during visits. The office is clean with a welcoming aura. I wouldn’t take my coonhound anywhere else.

reviews.name: Shawn McWhirter
reviews.text: If you want a knowledgeable and experienced veterinarian for your dog, I highly recommend Dr.Raj Salwan of Tricity Vet Hospital. He is always thorough with his exams and takes the time to address your queries and concerns.

reviews.name: Fran Holland
reviews.text: I have been taking my English bulldog to Dr. Raj for over three years, and he has never disappointed me. He is extensively experienced with this breed and understands what’s best for it. Highly recommended.

reviews.name: Bennett Schulte
reviews.text: Dr. Salwan took good care of our dog, Tom. He pays great attention to detail and explains everything to ensure you understand your options. I strongly recommend TriCity to everyone.

reviews.name: Katrice Sewell
reviews.text: Dr. Salwan is amazing. He is straightforward, takes the time to listen to your concerns, and always gives valuable advice about pet healthcare. The skilled and knowledgeable doctor has been taking care of my two cats for more than a year.

reviews.name: Trina Anderson
reviews.text:
today was my first visit and I had a great experience. Staff was very friendly and made the appointment easy.   I was reading past reviews on the cleanliness of the clinic and all I have to say is… it’s a hospital for animals— hair is inevitable. I saw a staff member cleaning and moping the floors.
I will be making this my go-to clinic for both my cats as of today.

reviews.name: Lillian Singer
reviews.text: Wonderful experience during my first visit to Tricity Vet Hospital. The appointment was timely and efficient. Dr. Raj answered all my questions and advised me on maintaining my dog’s health. I wouldn’t take my dog anywhere else.

reviews.name: TOMMY KEUNG
reviews.text: Help me dog when she was so sick with a stomach issue. Reassured us that she would be okay. Great service and great doctor 👍👍

reviews.name: Silver Spencer
reviews.text: Even though we live in Oakland, the trip to Tricity Vet Hospital in Fremont is always worth it. Dr. Raj Salwan takes great care of our two dogs and cat, and his rates are reasonable. He has friendly and helpful staff. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Brittany Dodge
reviews.text: Caring and dedicated staff that goes above and beyond to ensure all animals receive top-quality care. We couldn’t ask for a better vet and strongly recommend Tricity Vet Hospital.

reviews.name: Joe Montana
reviews.text: all this place wants is your money, I paid 250 dollars the first time and got misdiagnose so I had to pay another 250 for them to tell me my cat has worms, DO NOT go to this place unless you want to give them your money.

reviews.name: Rent Home
reviews.text: Decent vet but need more training for its staffs.

reviews.name: David Hirsch
reviews.text: Tri city is one of the best veterans I have been to. And I have had a lot of dogs. They really are nice.

reviews.name: SHXSH
reviews.text: I wish there is negative stars here!  Horrible services!  From front desk to inside, lies and lies!  The vat said my dog has three hot spot and need to be shaved and cleaned and give anti inflammation shots, alone with other procedures to do on my dog.  I don’t even want to mention how slow the girl checked me in for 30 min and she could get the file or computer right!  and when I picked my dog, and noticed that she only had one area shaved and hand shot, other two hot spots never treated!!!  Then I asked the from to ask the vet that he forgot.  Then there seems fear or something those girls will lie and say anything that they can’t talk to the vet because he is always with patience.  I waited and pleaded for half hour and looked at my poor dog with 11 stitches and need to bring her home.   Then soon, realized that the cone they put on her is so small and short that her nose and mouth are still can reach to her legs and lick and bites!!   So what the hack??!!  We  talk to them and the girls didn’t say anything!  And not even offer to change a bigger one,  then end up, I have to cut some hard plastic to extend it.  And then we have to replace the tape several times a day!  What a pain!!  When I say I need to speak to the vet, they said oh, if you want to talk to vet about that you need to pay exam fee $30???!!!  What you charged me almost 2000$, and you didn’t perform what you said and you charged me??  Also, I just went for removing the stitches, and the girl lie again about she couldn’t talk to the vet about why he didn’t treat her 3 hot spots !!! It’s a horrible service here, please LOVE your pet and stay away from here!    Will never come back here!!

reviews.name: Meghana Rao
reviews.text: Im going to this vet for 2 years now. The staff and the doctor make me wait for hours every single time. Why cant they book an appointment at a later time. What is the point of scheduling at all? Hours im not exaggerating. Im a mom with a newborn and I have a Doctors appointment scheduled 2 hours after this appointment and Im stuck here waiting for the Doctor to come out. Yes. My pet isnt looked at yet. God knows how long its going to take. Never coming here. If you value your time please dont come here. They waste people’s time.

reviews.name: Loreen Gorham
reviews.text: This was my second time taking my cat in for an ear infection at Tricity. Everyone there gave her an amazing treatment. They told me how to care for the ears and all the other possible protocols regarding it. I am grateful to Dr. Raj and his team at Tricity.

reviews.name: Alicia McLaughlin
reviews.text: My kitten needed to be spayed, and she received her care at Tricity Veterinary Hospital. Their team was skilled and professional and gave me clear, post-surgery care instructions and medication. They also reminded me of her follow-up appointment and all the necessary precautions.

reviews.name: Isaac Mitchell
reviews.text: I would like to express my sincere gratitude to the team at Tricity Veterinary Hospital for the superb service they offered our puppy, Emy. The team truly cares about dogs and treats their clients with the utmost respect. I wouldn’t take my dog anywhere else.

reviews.name: James Layton
reviews.text: I brought my cat to the Tricity Clinic due to breathing distress. Dr. Raj cared for him during his hospital stay and helped me in this condition. When the test results came in, he called and explained everything. A shout out for their excellent care and cooperation.

reviews.name: Rose S
reviews.text: Poor customer service,  poor and outdated and confused system!  It seems this place kept on hiring new staff.  They treat your pet as animal!  not part of your family member.  You almost will only have the chance to talk the vet a minute, the assistant just gave you a piece paper with many charges, and you want to talk to vet?  they always say he is with another patient?   Really????   will never recommend this place to anyone!!

reviews.name: Zack Woods
reviews.text: I would recommend TriCity Veterinary Hospital because they offer virtually all the vet services you would need for your pet. The facility is clean and has the latest equipment. Their experienced team is highly professional and dedicated to delivering the best care to your pet.

reviews.name: Ernest Perez
reviews.text: My dog had suffered from severe skin issues until a friend recommended me to Dr. Raj of Tricity Vet Hospital. The doctor gave a treatment routine that worked wonders. Milo’s hair has never looked this good and healthy. Thank you, Dr. Raj and your team.

reviews.name: Clem May
reviews.text: The Tricity Vet Hospital team took the best care of our kitten. The doctor addressed our questions and concerns patiently. I was nervous when we got to the clinic, but his consultation made me comfortable. I would highly recommend them for their amazing emergency setup and budget-friendly pricing.

reviews.name: Gale Baxter
reviews.text: We took three pets to Tricity for vaccines, surgery, and medical boarding. We are satisfied with Dr. Raj and their team's care for our pets. Their exam rooms are nice and well-equipped. And their reception staff is friendly and helpful as well.

reviews.name: Mara Walther
reviews.text: My husband decided to visit Tricity after reading all the positive reviews. They lived up to their claims. They examined our puppy and helped him survive a particularly deadly virus. He's also up and running around only one day after being home from his hospital stay.

reviews.name: Migdalia Simmerman
reviews.text: Our dog had a dry cough that got us worried. We brought him to Tricity, where he received the best care. Dr. Raj assured me everything was under control, and he needed normal care. Jasper got the right treatment, making me happy to see him healthy.

reviews.name: Dwight Nelson
reviews.text: I have visited several veterinarians for my pet over the years because of my job transfers. However, I have always found the best service and care at Tricity Vet Hospital among them. Dr. Raj and the staff always try to give an unbiased diagnosis.

reviews.name: Suzanne Sanders
reviews.text: I always consider Tricity as my go-to veterinary hospital in Fremont. I have been taking my cats there for the last three years. Their team always takes the time to examine the animals and ensure they give them a thorough diagnosis. I couldn’t be happier with their work.

reviews.name: James Heine
reviews.text: My dog had an issue with her eye, so I took her to Tricity for a quick check-up. After a detailed examination, the doctor prescribed some medicine. I appreciate their kindness, patience, and well-versed skills. Their customer service is exceptional, and they have our animals’ welfare at the core.

reviews.name: Kim Spencer
reviews.text: I had a lovely experience at Tricity Vet Hospital from when I booked my appointment to when I visited with my puppy. The staff was cooperative and helpful, and I appreciated the personalized attention they gave my pet. I also received follow-up calls regarding his post-consultation routine.

reviews.name: Tiffany Pettit
reviews.text: I have been taking my pets to this vet for many many years. I will now be looking for a new vet. The staff is not properly trained in customer service, they have no idea what is going on with your pet if someone from the back didn’t just tell them and they are extremely under staffed. The staff changes so often and they are very unprofessional. If you finally find a staff member you like don’t get too attached because they are usually gone in 3-4 months.My 14 year old dog gets her nails trimmed every 4-5 weeks. I was informed that she had an ingrown nail at her last appointment. No one had told me that she was having issues with her nails at any of her previous appointments. Which shouldn’t have even happened if the techs were trimming her nails correctly in the first place. Then, I was charged $432 to have her put under sedation to fix something that was their fault in the first place. I was initially quoted $130 over the phone. They were not willing to compromise on the price. I really expect more from a business that is owned and run by City Council member Raj Salwan. This vet needs to do better for its customers and the animals.

reviews.name: Joyce Chen Juri
reviews.text: took my robo dwarf hamster here to get a checkup & nail trim. all the staff were so friendly, it was a great experience!

reviews.name: TerryAnne Williams
reviews.text: Horrible clinic. The facility smells and is filthy. The staff is rude and not helpful.  Their staff member actually dropped my Boston Terrier on her head and did nothing to ensure she was ok. All she cared about was getting me out before other clients noticed.   She passed a month later.  I'll never take any Animal here again.

reviews.name: Chitra Patil
reviews.text:
I understand that everywhere there is shortage of staff, but giving an appointment and making you wait for more than an hour, and later saying that they will take the dog to the back to be examined --is just not acceptable.
I took time off from my work thinking it will take an hour with an appointment -- at the most. Our dog was stressed and anxious with all the wait in a lobby with strange dogs and cats. I didn't trust when they said, 'oh, it will just another 10 -15 minutes to examine and then we will get back to you'. I decided not to get her examined in a separate room when she was trembling after a long wait without any assurance how long it would take.
Do come here if you have the whole day to wait. The lobby was smelly and needed a thorough clean. Even urgent care for humans will not make you so long. I really miss Ardenwood pet hospital which closed earlier this year.

reviews.name: Jody Hart
reviews.text: Friendly and knowledgeable team. They are great with handling nervous dogs. I’m happy I discovered Tricity Veterinary Hospital.

reviews.name: J Sanchez
reviews.text: Highly recommend staying away from this place. Had been going there for years due to the cost but unfortunately you get what you pay for. A lot of turnover with the staff likely for good reason. Lobby and exam rooms are always dirty and staff constantly makes mistakes.  Picked up my dog after a major surgery and was disappointed to see him and his bandage were covered in urine. Not sure why they would send him home like that and tell me to leave his bandage on till the next day.  Made a complaint and was called a liar by the Dr./owner  himself. Said 4 people from his Staff told him what I said was not true (likely because i wiped him down with napkins before they took him to the back to remove bandage). Rather than hear me out and apologize  Dr. Salwan told me I've always been a problem and that I ask too many questions.  Are you kidding me I'm supposed to ask questions before letting you cut my dog open. Took him back so they could remove his stitches from 2 incisions and what do you know they forgot remove one of them. While I will say Dr. Salwan is a good surgeon his people skills, professionalism and owner representation are a joke. Zero empathy for my concerns. Affordability makes people want to come here but if you are looking for quality and integrity choose somewhere else

reviews.name: evelyn mateo
reviews.text: I took my dog for a dental cleaning and everything went perfectly. I dropped her off in the AM and they called me right when they were done to let me know how it went. She stayed for observation and was ready for pick up! My dogs have been going here for 7 years and never had a problem with them. Thank you so much!

reviews.name: Heather P
reviews.text: This is our first time using Tri-city Vet. They are very professional, and Brittany and Marissa are AMAZING (10 stars for them)!! All the staff is helpful as well. Definitely will be using them again. The meds we got for our foster kitten was available at their location, so we didn't need to run around and get a prescription filled like we had to at other vet offices.  Thank you ALL for your help!!

reviews.name: Saeed Qazi
reviews.text: I feed 2feral cats .Last week one cat came limping in one leg .She was in great pain .I wanted to show her to vet .I was not getting imidiate appt.then I called tricity and they gave me same day appt .Staff was good .I didnt have to wait too long .Dr.said she has abcess and gave her injection and antibiotics .Next day she was Ok and started walking again .I am very pleased with tricity vet service .

reviews.name: Ashish Somireddy
reviews.text: Worst service ever. Our cat had a problem with his ear and we made an appointment for our cat at 10:30 am, they took him and made us wait for one and half hours, and still when we asked for an update they haven’t done anything by 12:00pm. We also had other doctors appointments so we asked them how long would it take for him. Instead of apologizing for the delay they started being rude to us by saying “who asked you to wait here, you could have gone for your appointment and come back to pick the cat later.” Then they asked us to pay for a bunch of tests. We took our cat as asked them to transfer all his records to a different vet. The other vet mentioned that its hard to request the records of pets for Tricity because their service is terrible. Never going back again.

reviews.name: Frans Ndilipunye Mathews
reviews.text: We have been taking our pets to Tricity for over 15 years. They are extremely professional, knowledgeable, and caring. They have a clean office and state-of-the-art equipment. Thank you, Dr. Raj, and your staff for taking great care of our pets all these years.

reviews.name: suraya entezam
reviews.text: They’re Really bad they lose your cats and Dodd and Front desk people are so bad

reviews.name: Joshua Handjojo
reviews.text:
This clinic has a good and reasonably priced puppy package that is quite comprehensive in terms of the vaccines, microchip, and physical examinations it includes. Dr. Salwan has always been a great vet to my puppy and loved his expert knowledge.

It's what everything else around the vet that is not working at all. The staff seem very young and often deal with customer service very poorly. There were typos in my contact information previously, miscalculation of total invoices (w/puppy package discount), and low attentiveness to people waiting.

I would rate this place a 1.5 star, and the worst experience I had was that I wasn't even provided my dog's microchip number when he received it. It wasn't until I came back for some of his booster shots, that I realized I was never instructed to register the microchip, which they also lost his number!

The staff needs a lot of work and professionalism. Not sure I will be returning...

reviews.name: Dillon Sappingfield
reviews.text: We had an emergency over the weekend and they were more kind and generous than I could have ever hoped for. Our ferret had an obstruction in his digestive system and was not going to make it for long. They offered to do the surgery for significantly less than the other emergency clinic we visited. I cannot recommend them any more than possible. Really they deserve every bit of business they receive and more. I wish they were a 24 hour clinic, there aren't many left.

reviews.name: Keri Cox
reviews.text: I can’t recommend this clinic highly enough. The office is clean, spacious, and welcoming. They are flexible with appointments and won’t keep you waiting during your visit. Their rates are fair and won’t pressure you to pay for unnecessary treatments or medication. They put your pet’s health above everything else.

reviews.name: Todd Chapa
reviews.text: The Tricity team is so good with pets that Chloe is always excited during her vet appointments. I recommend this clinic to anyone looking for the best care for their four-legged friends.

reviews.name: Randall Schisler
reviews.text: Dr. Raj Salwan is very professional,  friendly, and compassionate. He will patiently explain everything and answer your questions. In the end, your pet will get the best care possible. He deserves 5 stars!

reviews.name: Julian Dexter
reviews.text: I was in yesterday for an emergency, and the Tricity team did an excellent job. They are professional and efficient; you can trust them with your pet’s life.

reviews.name: fatima naranjo
reviews.text: this is a horrible, horrible place. if i could give it a zero i absolutely would. i took my dog to get a rabies vaccine along with the bordetella. she did not come back the same. as soon as they handed her back to me i knew something was wrong. she started throwing up on the floor and as soon as she stoped she let herself fall. i let a woman know and they took her to the back again. they didnt let me know anything until i asked. they later took me to a room with my husband and she supposedly had an allergic reaction which makes absolutely no sense cause she has had that vaccine before and didnt had any reaction to it or any other vaccines. i took her home and she couldnt even stand straight. she threw up once again and almost did two times more. they told me to monitor her. i had to ask a cousin living in mexico, who is a vet, for help. i believe they didnt give her the right vaccine. i will absolutely bot be coming back to this disgusting place and please do not bring your pets here.

reviews.name: Albert Luz
reviews.text: Man acted greedy suggested other vets wanted 39$ didn't 3ven mention 15$ first time coupon no advice only arrogance
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thanks for your feedback. Pet had a major issue requiring treatment and owner wanted to poke it with a needle at home. We suggested to bring in so the pet doesn’t end up in a worse situation than it currently is. We are happy to give home remedies, but we can’t give bad advice which would make the patient worse off than they are. We believe in “Do No Harm” first. We are happy to give you a new client discount.

reviews.name: Eric New
reviews.text: Jasper had a persistent cough that got us worried. We brought him to Tricity, where he received first-rate care as usual. After a comprehensive exam, Dr. Raj assured us that everything was under control. Jasper got the right treatment, and it melts my heart to see him healthy and happy today.

reviews.name: Ram Prasadh Parthasarathy
reviews.text: Doesn't value your time at all !! give you an appointment and doesn't honor that, make you wait for 1-2 hours anyways.

reviews.name: Eric Nubla
reviews.text: Took my dog to get neutered as well as microchipped. We were told to come back 2 weeks after to remove the stitches (which is fine). However, when we came back, my girlfriend out of the blue, just wanted to verify the information that was linked to his microchipping and asked what information they had - but it turns out that they never even performed the microchipping! If she had never asked, we would have never known and thought it was done when he was neutered! We didnt know we were supposed to be given a code and register him! When I first brought him in, I thought that was done with the contact information we provided for the neuter.  God forbid he had gotten lost at anytime without a collar, we would have assumed he had the microchipping and they would be able to contact us. HOW DO YOU PAY FOR A PROCEDURE AND NOT DO THE PROCEDURE!?!? I will never return - I can't trust them if this is how they operate.

reviews.name: Charnjeet Singh
reviews.text: Two things wrong with his place and the price and the service. They wouldn’t see my dog because they didn’t have a doctor in-house, What kind of pet clinic that is open 24 hours doesn’t have a doctor in house?

reviews.name: Glen So
reviews.text: Terrible customer service. Sat in the waiting room for 30 minutes after signing in. No one at reception bother to look at the sign in sheet.

reviews.name: Rose Bales
reviews.text: After a very rude experience with our normal vet, I was told to go here. I was so delighted by the amazing customer service and dedication this vet had. I was on my way to board my four fur babies when I realized they all needed updated vaccinations before we moved. I used to work at a vet an knew this would only need to be a tech appointment at our normal vet. When I got to our normal vet I was met with ignorance, unintrest, and felt like I wasnt welcome because I brought in all four cats at once. She said they were fully booked and couldn't take them in the rudest way possible. So I headed to tricity. Not only were we new clients but four new clients so I figured they would turn me away. Instead I was just informed they would need and exam and would fit me in around other appointments. The staff was friendly the doctor was amazing and this will now be put permanent vet. They got everything done in a timely manner and I appreciate them alot for everything they did today.

reviews.name: Annmargaret Ricamara
reviews.text: Lazy staff they will not going to ask you what you there for they just gonna look at you. And when you call at the business hours they Rarely answer the phone. So sad good business but staff are lazy.

reviews.name: Xavier Quinonez
reviews.text: If you love your animals and value competency, please take your animals else where. Overall, I’ve had good experiences with animal hospitals, but this place is awful. I purchased the mid tier puppy package (over a year ago) for $200 and brought my dog in the times required for him to meet all his vaccination requirements and recently found out that they never issues him his Bordetella. When I asked them why that was and they said that they only issue vaccinations the owner consented too, placing the blame on me, but why would I opt out of having my dog vaccinated for just that one thing? I’m very confident that they know this was an error made on their end. They also claimed that my file shows no puppy package, but it says it on the paper work I had them email me.

reviews.name: NS
reviews.text: I've been to this vet hospital for a few years with my dogs, but frankly IF YOU HAVE A MAJOR CONCERN for your dog, DO NOT come here! My dog was extremely lethargic +constantly vomiting. We went to this vet everyday and all they gave him some injections and some IV fluids and told us to wait a few more days, but our dog was continuously deteriorating rapidly. I ended up saying screw that and took him to another vet that diagnosed him WITHIN the same appointment. The vet I went to said the test they conducted is the first thing this vet hospital should have done with the symptoms shown, and referred us immediately to an ER nearby. Being a healthcare worker, I KNOW when something is not right and I KNOW the signs/symptoms, whether its a dog or a human. The fact that the doctor was so nonchalant with our concerns and told us to wait a few more days that could have our dog reach a point of no going back, has us beyond furious and we don't know if our dog will survive now. The staff is nice and accommodating, but if you have a major concern for your dog, don't go to this doctor. This place is only good for basic necessities.

reviews.name: LaTasha Duplessis
reviews.text: The staff is very unprofessional. I had an appointment for my dog. My son got lost trying to find the place. He arrived 3 minutes late and they refused to treat my dog. They do not care about pets. I do not recommend this place!!

reviews.name: Shadiah MacClary
reviews.text:
This is the most unclean, unfriendly, unprofessional business I’ve ever been to.  When I walked in the entire place smelled like animal urine. The floors were dirty and there were urine footprints all over the lobby.
An issue I was happy to overlook until my experience with the Vet Tech.

While I was in appointment I received a message that my mother with stage 4 cancer was experiencing and emergency and I had to divide my attention between my pet appointment and communication coming from the hospital.

She came in to give me a price breakdown and I told her whatever was needed just write it up and I would pay for it. I was not giving my full attention and I would describe my responses as curt. The tech was frustrated and walked out and slammed the door.

I met her in the hall and apologized for my lack of focus and if I seemed rude and explained that I had a medical emergency I was trying to manage with my mother and her slamming the door was not helpful or necessary. To which she replied and yelled out as she walked down the hall, “You need to learn to handle things better.”

I was so shocked I asked to speak to a supervisor. Then all three of the front desk assistants and the doctor went in a back room, had a conversation about me and what happened and left me, the paying customer waiting for an additional 20 minutes.

I drive from Santa Clara and paid $619.85 to have a door slammed in my face, to be yelled at by a vet tech in front of other pet owners, and to be dismissed by the Veterinarian.

I don’t recommend this place to anyone if you have another choice.

reviews.name: Nicole Ureno V (Nicole)
reviews.text: Same experience from the comment below. My cat still sick,  she was vomiting, coughing, and she had strong pain on her abdomen. So I took her there and they put IV.Then they did a blood test. I never heard from the results back. So I called more then 4 times and they say "the doctor will call you to give you the results" and will never call me back. I waited 3 WEEKS to finally get the results. When I was on the phone with the doctor he sound very rush. Didn't really explain well, and just told me there is nothing to worry about. My cat still feeling sick, she hasn't been feeling any better.

reviews.name: ernesto dela cruz
reviews.text: The doctor is okay but the staff is so inefficient. Does not give clear information, it's like pulling teeth, drip, drip, drip. Lab test that should take 2 to 3 days, after a week your still waiting for the call, antibiotic dosage not enough, like they just estimated the amount. Brought our pet and then was told to wait in the waiting area. I thought they will let us know when our pet is ready, just like when you service your car, when done, they take your car out and you pay. After two hours, I found out that I was to wait "in line to pay and only then they will call us". The rest of the sentence was missing.

reviews.name: Ambrea Phillips
reviews.text:
Don't come here if you have birds. Not a specialist. Doesn't ask enough questions. Doesn't listen. Wants to do diagnostics tests and charge more. Also took 2 hours for a scheduled appointment. I believe all of the good reviews are from spam accounts. So I've been reporting them.

reviews.name: Sami
reviews.text:
There is the worst vet.

reviews.name: Alex Li

reviews.name: zamangel2002
reviews.text:
Dr is great. Office staff incompetent..Prescription states tablets, to be fed half, content is capsules..

2nd visit went great. Meds issue is due to avail...chalk it down to covid...

reviews.name: Georgina Rodriguez
reviews.text: Once again they treated my referral as family. Chachita is doing extraordinary. Thank you so much for your help and professionalism.  Still driving from San Francisco just to make sure I'm very well taken care of. Always THANK YOU!!!

reviews.name: Kamilah Clay
reviews.text: Took my puppy to get spayed. When I picked her up I was charged an additional charge. The dr said my puppy was in heat. Which I know is not true because she was in heat in September. There’s no way she is still in heat at the end of November. Every time I go there is always something extra they are charge lung me for. Staff is not friendly. The young guy sitting there this morning did not acknowledge me. He looked at me and didn’t say one word. I Waited at-least 10 mins standing there until  someone came from the back to say something.

reviews.name: J Fen
reviews.text: I went to this veterinarian based off of its review supposedly supposed to be the best in 2020 2021 but they gave me false information which almost led me to lose my dog she was pregnant the doctor told me she only had two puppies she had five . Not only did they tell me they were two puppies they told me my dog would be able to push them out with no problem that was a lie. And told me to wait until day 65 that is entirely too long by that time puppies have died inside of my dog causing an infection which led me to have to pay for an emergency C-section which was well over $9000 I will not be recommending this vet to anybody all they want is your money they will schedule you for a appointment as soon as possible just to get your money . I’ve been trying to call I’ve been put on hold 5 times 4 over an hour Who does that to their paying customers and patients doesn’t seem like they care about the animals they are only in it for the money

reviews.name: Rich Coffeen
reviews.text:
I am very happy with my experience at Tricity Veterinary Hospital. The staff was very helpful and courteous. My dog had his teeth cleaned 4 years ago and it cost me $1,204.00 and I was not happy; a lot of tarter was still plainly visible on his teeth. When I was told he needed another cleaning I  looked for another place to take him. A girlfriend recommended Tricity.
They did a beautiful job at 1/4 of the price of my previous vet. And his teeth are sparkling white. Now when I give him his nightly mint chew his breath actually smells like mint!

reviews.name: Alexandria Silva
reviews.text: I took my dog to get neutered and a couple weeks later came back for stitch removal. I kid you not they literally released him to me with all his stitches still in. I brought him back and complained and then paid an additional $15 for a nail trim. Took him home and noticed his stitches were STILL THERE and they DIDNT cut his nails at ALL. It was the weirdest and grimiest experience I have had at a vet. I had to take the stitches out myself because I didn’t trust them to do anything if I went back a third time. Let’s just say this is the only and last time I took my dog to this untrustworthy vet. They are wildly unprofessional and will take your money while leaving your animal in pain.

reviews.name: Kittiblu
reviews.text:
The doctor is very helpful. But the staff is questionable. They seem confused a lot of the time and don't seem very competent when handling money. There's an acute lack of communication among the staff. Otherwise, our pet was really well cared for.

I give it two stars b/c at least I got my cat back. No one ended up dead.

reviews.name: Andy Buzzbuzz
reviews.text: The front desk associates have no clue on giving suggestion and not professional.  I did my dog multiple blood works, x-rays and tests but never gave me a follow up call to see that was going on.  I had to call myself to find out.  Front desk associates are just there to collect money and key in appointments.  They all have no idea on how to handle certain situations and suggestions.  They do a poor quality work on checking out your pets.  My suggestion is Do Not Take your pet here.

reviews.name: Richard Cheng
reviews.text:
This place is pits. Based on past experience I Went to this place because I know my dog needed prescription for muscle relaxer and pain killer. They have seen my dog for same problem in the past. But they required my doc to see a vet before giving the prescription. Fair enough.

Even tho I told them I was in a rush, the appointment  process took 1 hr.  Everything was set in extra slow motion. Even after the vet talked to me it was another  1/2 hr before I could see my dog again

Instead of prescribing  the same medication as the first, they came back with a long list that was more expensive and when I questioned them it was going nowhere. reviews.name: Sabrina Italia
reviews.text: After reading some of the reviews I was a little concerned, but I had a good experience. The doctor was thorough, and the receptionist was friendly. My only feedback is about the floors, it’s a large space so I understand that pet hair may be hard to keep up with though! Overall a very good experience.

reviews.name: Willow Rose
reviews.text:
If it weren’t for Dr. Salwan, I wouldn’t come here.

Most of the staff in the front office are rude, obnoxious, and downright disrespectful! If I were hiring them, I would put them on a one week probation to see if they can measure up. My comment here is so consistent with other reviews that you would think they would hire and screen candidates more diligently.

In addition, you have to call them to find out when you can pick up your pet after surgery even after they tell you when you drop them off to expect a call when they are ready. This is absurd! It’s like pulling teeth interacting with these people.

I gave it 3 stars only because I believe Dr. Salwan is a good doctor but I would give less than zero stars for the people up front working for him.

I’ll give it one more try and if the attitude and interactions are the same with the front staff, sorry, Dr. Salwan but you will lose me as a longtime client.

reviews.name: Jimmy Neutron
reviews.text: This place is so unprofessional I called once and they said to put me on a brief hold. I waited 15 minutes and no one came back.

reviews.name: Lida R
reviews.text: TERRIBLE PLACE! I had taken my pupy for a booster vaccination and checkup. Our appointment was at 3 and we started at 4. The vet the tried to convince us that our puppy needed 3 extra vaccinations just for the money and when i had asked then to trim the puppies nails they cut one way too  short and hit a nerve we brought home a very trembling puppy. I plead you not to mke the same mistake I did with these people.

reviews.name: Joe Lin
reviews.text: If there is 0 star I would give. The city should shut this place down. 4 years ago, I brought my cat in, walked out with $2,000 and a dead cat. I can't believe it happened again. Walk in with a live cat, 3 days later, $1800 bill and a dead cat. Can't tell me what happened. Doctor would not speak to me. This is not a hospital, this is a for profit death machine. They should all be terminated and thrown in jail.

reviews.name: Diana Bik
reviews.text:
I just started going to this place now that we live in Fremont and while the vets seem competent enough  prices reasonable,  the front desk admin. operation is so disorganized, chaotic and flaky I will never return. I don't blame the front office as much as the management who obviously aren't adequately training and overseeing their operation.
1..Got cat neutered and was told someone would call at noon with an update on how surgery went. Received no call and when I went to pick up waited for 30 mins to be acknowledged, staff finally said they'd go in back to retrieve,  never returned-- asked someone else to assist, went in back to retrieve-- came back out 15 mins later with cat and then hurried away giving no post surgery instructions, no followup apt. to remove stitches,  no info. about when cone can be removed.
2. Just now we've called them 4 separate times this morning to find out cost of their sedatives since we'll be traveling with our cat. First attempt were told they only have tranquilizers, no sedatives but would check on that and call back. No return call. Called later and each time a harried recep. picked up and put me on hold for 8 plus mins with no pick up.
This place is horribly managed! do not recommend!!

reviews.name: Megan Briceno
reviews.text:
DO NOT TAKE YOUR PET HERE IF YOU CARE ABOUT IT'S LIFE.  Lazy my canine furbaby died due to their negligence.

We took Lazy in and the Dr Buhllar ordered blood test. We were told the  results would be returned same day.  However, the results were not provided for 2 WEEKS!!!! Despite our calls we were hung up, left on hold or dismissed they act bothered that were instant on answers as our little girls health was declining. .

When they did answer the call we were told to just wait they were getting the results as soon as possible. One instance, we were told only a Dr could read the results..

On the initial  she was given antibiotics and vitamin B. When we saw an increase in her energy we were hopeful as we waited for blood test results though  we still feared the worst.  My husband was literally crying for help the Dr finally read the results. He was very nonchalant in his response despite our worry he brushed off our concerns saying that only her liver enzymes were high and perhaps we should have xray of her abdomen. There was nooo sense of urgency.

I got a second opinion immediately..

The  Dr. at the second vet said the results did not match the health of what he observed in Lazy. He thought either the sample was incorrect or that it might have been a bad sample.
As it turned out we were right to not trust Tri City or Dr Buhllar. The test results from Tri City were VERY different from the tests run the next day at the second vet.

The new Dr pointed out this may have been  because Tri city ran the tests 13 days !!! after obtaining the sample on Lazys visit. Or perhaps they lost or mixed up the sample. I don't know which  but there was absolutely something wrong with the test in addition to the 2 week delay of results.
The second vet stated that if they had seen Lazy earlier she would have most likely lived longer and that at the very least she would have not died so painfully. When we asked he recommended us to take action against the vet. We immediately filed a complaint to the veterinary board.

Lazy suffered because of Tri City's negligence. Had they completed the test results as promised we would have sought second  opinion sooner. Or had they communicated that they would not run the test right away we would have sought second opinion sooner. Lazy would not have not died a slow painful death.

In addition, take a look at their yelp reviews. Several accounts are listed of people's animals dying due to their negligence. I only wish we had reviewed the yelp listing sooner. But we went to Tri City on recommendation from a friend. They were lucky enough to have a different outcome.

Please do not allow your beloved pets to be at risk! Lazy did not deserve to suffer because of the negligence of Tri City . I hope my Lazy rests in peace. She passed September of 2018. The veterinary board has just contacted me again about her case. I hope she gets justice.

reviews.name: matu reese
reviews.text: The receptionist are very unprofessional...I was not even acknowledge  when I walked in the building at all for over 10 mins until I said something to them. They  were talking to each other and answering the phone calls. It’s okay to answer the phone calls but put them on hold and help the customers in front of you.

reviews.name: lynda freeman
reviews.text: So, I'm reading comments about this place and I have to let any other person who reads the comments know that there isnt a dr. Raj nor a doctor salaam nor a doctor wise at tri-city vet. They are leaving reviews for other vet offices. Now, if you are trying to read comments on tri-city vet then here is a reliable one. I have been coming here for years and yes it has its ups and downs but the prices are great and the vets are so caring and thorough. Sebastian the tech is amazing. All new staff up front that are doing a better job then last batch of employees. They have saved my cats lives on multiple occasions and helped us through some very tough times. Dr. Salwan is great and dr.buhlar is amazing as well. You may experience  a few days of not getting a call back right away with test results but if you keep calling or go in you will get a dr on the phone or in person to explain results. They dont push services on you they only reccomend and they listen to you. I wouldnt change my vet for anything. They are like family. I highly recommend this place. Just remember, they are super busy and do their best to get you as soon as they can. They are also great with surgeries and follow ups.

reviews.name: Susan D'Angelo
reviews.text: I love Tricity Veterinarian.  The main thing is that so does my dog.  It’s very easy to get an appointment and the staff is professional.  I am truly thankful for this clinic!.

reviews.name: Mechele Oliveira
reviews.text: Horrible place! I waited 50 min to drop off my kittens for a simple spay when I had an appointment. The receptionist took 3 clients before me, that arrived after me. They tried to double charge me for the medicine. The antibiotic were warm when they are supposed to be refrigerated! They then charged me $35.00 extra per kitten because the doctor said my kittens were in heat, when I know for FACT that they were NOT in heat! Had to wait another hour to pick them up and once again the receptionist's took  4 people that arrived after me. Then the icing on the cake.... my kittens came home with FLEAS!!!  Don't waist your time with the frustration this place offers! I gave them 1 star for the only positive... My kittens were alive when I went to get them!!!

reviews.name: Sachna Raj
reviews.text: I have been going to this hospital from past 14 years, just because of quality and professional people in this hospital i have not tries any other veterinarian. Thank you to the team of doctors at Tricity.

The people who don’t catch an attitude if someone only wants their name right on the paper.

reviews.text: DO NOT GO THIS PLACE if you care about your pets' life. The receptionists there keep lying. For your pets' safety, please do not trust them. reviews.text: Need better hygiene,  always new ppl , hardly see Dr around , there's always the MAs

out of a 1500$ bill I opted for a only a few services  & now they will not respond with the “lab” results.

reviews.text: Dr Raj is a top notch vet. He is caring and informative. He is very reliable and professional and is very fair with his pricing. My pups and I love him.

reviews.name: Caroline Tien-Spalding
reviews.text: Took in a cat who had escaped and come back. He was very skinny. Got an appointment in 48h. Now I know why. Very slow once there, put him on IV so they could draw blood for tests. We were told we'd get test results within 2-3 days. It's been TWO WEEKS. I've now called 4 times. Every single time: the doctor is at lunch (no matter what time of day it is), hold for 20min, say they're going to call you back. They don't call back. On 4th call I asked to get the test results by voicemail. I haven't gotten them. We're about to take them to small claims court. This is fraud, to say you're doing to take money for test results and never deliver them. Don't waste your money.

reviews.name: Jeannine Churchill
reviews.text: The office staff is a bit rocky but the vet is top notch! He loves all animals like they are his own.

reviews.name: Cody S
reviews.text: The place as an instant aroma of urine and facies, the workers behind the desk are completly rude and just want you out, the docotor shouldnt even have his license , gave medicatiosn to my dog that made him have rashes and hives all over his body

reviews.name: Cheryl Lovato
reviews.text:
15 years ago I found this Vet when my cat was very sick.  Dr Salwan was amazing, kind and helped me through a cancer diagnosis and treatment.  Never had any issues with the staff, etc.  Years later, my other cat came down with the same cancer and Dr Salwan was again, very helpful and compassionate.

Fast forward to now and the story is VASTLY different.  I called last Sunday to get help for my 1.5yr cat who hadn't used the litter box is a few days and was vomiting liquid (he is known to try to eat anything he can find, just like a puppy).  They could not see him.  Not only that but the girl on the other end of the line was rude and dismissive.  What a horrible way to treat someone who has a sick animal.  I ended up taking kitty to Beacon for emergency service.  They were compassionate, responsive and helpful.  Bloodwork, x-rays, fluids......unfortunately no diagnosis was found.

Follow up today with his regular vet and we saw Dr Salwan.  I was hopeful for the same good service I'd once had.  I left kitty for x-rays and expected a call back to discuss next step.  3 hrs later I called to check, the answer was simply "you can come pick him up now".  Wait, what?  What's wrong with him?  How are we going to fix it?  Nobody has contacted me.  I am then told oh sorry, x-ray results take 1-2 days, doctor will talk to you then.  I'm sorry but the cat is not eating, is dehydrated and has not had a bowel movement in a week.  I am absolutely disgusted with this service.  This is a life we are talking about, a member of my family.  I have now spent $1600 and my cat is still very sick with no path forward.  This is unacceptable.  What has happened to this place?

Additionally, I neglected to comment on the fact that I had a similar incident in August with my 9yo cat.  Took days to get results from his x-rays.  Many phone calls, thankfully, his was a minor issue and was resolved easily.......luckily.

Dr Salwan is a good Vet, WHEN he is onsite.  Seems he doesn't work there much anymore and the staff is overworked and frustrated.  This may be an OK place if you need simple things like vaccinations or a simply check-up.  But for Gods sake, don't bring your animal here if it is ill, who knows how long it will take to get them checked IF they can even see you when you need to be seen.

First time I've ever written a review..... I hope this helps prevent the anxiety and needless cost that I 've had.....and still with no fix for my sweet little cat.

Update : 4 days later, Dr still hasn't called to talk to me about the results.

reviews.text: We took our puppies for vaccines, and when we called afterwards to ask which vaccines were taken, they said that the vaccines were not taken.

reviews.name: Marie de Luna
reviews.text: We have been coming to this hospital for years and never had problems until now.  We are very disappointed with our service.  We brought our dog in for an exam and also had x-rays done.  We did the x-rays and was told they need to do further ultrasound to determine diagnosis (we had two options, but could only take one of the options due to the fact they did not have a particular specialist onsite... reviews.name: jordan delury
reviews.text: DO NOT GO HERE unless you want to wait an hour to see a vet, wait another hour to get your animal back after a procedure, be put on hold for 45 mins only for someone to hang up on you and pay extra money for bloodwork and not have it be offered to you after having it be recommended. We had to take our cat to another pet hospital because his ear was still infected, the new pet hospital prescribed the same ear medication as tricity but told us it needed to be refrigerated so we were probably giving our pet expired medication. On top of that, the new pet hospital tried calling tricity for previous records and were told they have no record of us after the receptionist was diligent enough to put in the correct number after being told multiple times. Prices may be seem appealing but do not go here, they are clearly understaffed and the receptionists have no idea how to handle a busy situation.

reviews.name: Cinnamongirl Inc.
reviews.text: I have been a client for over a year. I have had very positive experiences with the front desk and Dr. Raj. He went through a very challenging time with my little dog where no other vet could diagnose her weight loss. Dr. Raj put her on some basic food for digestive issues and a light dose of Pepsid AC. Bella began to eat much better and was back to her old self.

reviews.name: Edith Victoria
reviews.text:
I will never recommend this place to anyone on the planet.

First, it took such a long time just to get someone to answer the phone. I was put on hold twice for 10 minutes each time. It’s severely understaffed.

Second, they didn’t honour thier own price of $65 for my cats neuter. It cost me $130. The girl who helped me her exact words “We need to change the website, we are vet people not computer people.” What does that mean!?
It clearly says on the website that price is valid until 12/2020 which makes no sense at all.

Finally, when picking him up it took so long and I was so mad. There was no one at the counter to help. Once someone did help me, they asked if I had brought a carrying case or box. I had brought him in his own case!

This is a place you come if you have no other choice. I made a huge mistake by bringing my cat here and I hope that this review will save others time, money, and effort.

Please don’t bring your pets here. It has been a horrible experience. The ladies working the front look overwhelmed. The owner and vet should be ashamed.

reviews.name: Stan DeSouza
reviews.text: Called about my dog having fleas.  The vet tech Pranjali was a good listener, very helpful and informative.  Went in and was glad to meet her in person, as she was once again courteous and helpful.

reviews.name: Anika Wyrick
reviews.text: I recently visited this vet with a stray kitten I saved. I was told the first exam would be free & took him in. When I arrived I was told he needed tests to check his stomach, which we paid for because we were told he was very ill with stomach problems. We noticed before we left that we were also charged for the visit. We asked to have that refunded but I was already alarmed with the lack of communication and follow thru. As days went on I called because I had heard nothing about the tests the vet recommended. I called the first time & was told by a very rude employee that the lab had a mix up & it would take longer for results then without even a sorry or goodbye I was hung up on. I waited two more days only to call & find out that they had no results & needed another sample from my kitten, that they claimed was close to death but if so why wasn't there any follow thru with his tests. I asked for a refund on the test & told them I would be taking my kitten to another vet.  I was told my refund for just the test would be given but there was no responsibility taken for the poor service or the fact my animal was not treated as a priority. I strongly suggest taking your animals to another vet that will take your beloved animals health issues seriously & not waste time & take your money with no results or apology. I was extremely disappointed with this vet because this was a scary & dangerous situation for my kitten & they could care less to even understand my feelings & frustration from their mix up. I paid them $300.00 only for them to screw up my animals tests & give me no answers. Now I've wasted a whole week & have to put my kitten thru another exam with another vet because my time & hard earned money was wasted. The staff needs to work on their follow thru & bedside manner because they suck at customer service.

reviews.name: Celeste Conroy
reviews.text:
My negative experiences here only involved the front desk receptionists.
Upon calling to schedule my first appointment, I felt that the receptionist was rude and I was surprised that she was uninterested in the reasoning for my requested vet visit.
I arrived at the facility and walked across the large waiting area towards the two women; one of which shouted at me multiple times to “sign in over there”.... “sign in over there”... while pointing. How incredibly unprofessional.
I continued to approach the desk and informed the woman that I was a new patient and I was wondering if there was any paperwork I needed to fill out. “Oh” she says and then hands me a clipboard and paper. I return the paperwork to her and await my appointment.
My appointment time arrives and I am informed by the receptionist who instead of walking over to me decides to yell across the facility that the doctor will be late. I ask her how late she thinks and she shrugs then tells me like 10 minutes. Super professional people.
17 minutes after my appointment time, I am called to the back and roomed. Luckily, the doctor I saw was amazing and had a very professional demeanor. After the appointment was over I walked with a vet tech to the front desk and was checked out. I was very relieved that she seemed to know how to do her job and present herself in a professional manner. I requested for an email of the combined vaccination records, as I had provided all previous vaccination records from my previous vet, so that I could forward them to our boarding facility.
Upon receiving them, I was taken aback by the sheer lack of effort in creating my file. I informed them via phone call of the error in my address and the dates that did not correctly correspond with the previous vet vaccination record due dates that they had merged into their system. I was informed there was nothing she could do right now to correct that because they were “closing in TEN MINUTES” and she will just “make sure I do not get any notifications since the info is wrong”...
Low-cost vet but you truly get what you pay for.
Thank you to the doctor who treated myself and my dog well but we will not be returning.

reviews.name: Nate Kyng
reviews.text:
I'm only giving one star, because I have to, but if I had a choice, I would give none.

I brought my 4 month old teacup puppy in after he was showing signs of being wobbly, tired and completely out of it. The doctor, a heavy set Indian man (he never told us his name) came in with zero emotion and did an "exam" on our puppy. His exam consisted of checking his heart beat, his gums and pressing in certain areas of his body; no temperature check and no ear check, which is a pretty common practice when performing a physical exam on any animal.

He then suggested $600 worth of blood tests, x-rays and medications. However, we can't afford that so we opted out of the blood tests and x-rays and just got the medications. He told us our pup would receive a shot to help rehydrate his body and another that would be an antibiotic. However, later in the evening when we were looking up the side effects of the medication he was given since he was showing weakness and pain in his sides and back, we found out it wasn't an antibiotic at all. It was instead an antiemetic which is to help stop vomiting (which wasn't a major concern when we brought him in).

While we were waiting for his shots to be done, a man came in saying that he had called CHP about a cat being hit by a car and was told they brought the cat here...He asked about the cat's well being and they said the cat was very aggressive, and would be sent to the SPCA where they would probably not adopt it out and then put it down. The man wanted to adopt the cat to save it from such a fate, and the same doctor who saw us, tried to talk him out of it. I couldn't believe it!

Do NOT take your pet here ever. They don't care about your animals, they care about their checks. All those "Google User" reviews are fake reviews from the company itself trying to praise themselves so that suckers like us come in. They are absolutely insincere, lack compassion, and really only want as much money as they can get from you...and my dog isn't even better.

Thinking about suing this place. BEWARE!!
