reviews.name: Ian Freeman
reviews.text: These people have always been helpful and sympathetic regardless of pet. We started with hamsters and have been "adopted" by cats (4 of them). Their help and advice has always been kind and courteous. Dr's are wonderful. Two of the four cats were already pregnant so we progressed to 10 kittens (not planned but taken care of now). Throughout all this everyone was helpful. The kittens actually like their visits to the "second home" aka Tri City

reviews.name: Natasha D'Gracia
reviews.text: I am surprised is still even open. My dog broke out in hives one day and we had originally scheduled her to see one of the veterinarian at 12:00. Once I showed up with my dog, they stated that he wasn't even there and would not be in until 2! They continuous fail to inform their patients owners, they repeatedly make billing mistakes and every time I go there, the facility is so disgusting! The lady with blonde hair in the front is ALWAYS so rude and does not hesitate to express your carelessness of the animals and the people that walk through that door. I have already spoken to the manager in regards to this TWICE and surprisingly that lady still has a job there. DO NOT EVER take your animal there on the weekends or in general if you care for your pets! If I could do 0 stars, i would!

reviews.name: Edimil David
reviews.text: The Vet Hospital is clean. Staffs are friendly and helpful. My previous Vet do overcharged me but this place have very reasonable price. On my own experience, thumbs up!👍

reviews.name: kamlesh sharma
reviews.text: Very affordable and good care. May not be the best if severe  pet illness and so people should not expect exceptional treatment as such low prices. But for routine exams and care, I found very easy to simply walk in without any appointments and get the necessary advise or treatment.

reviews.name: Collin Chen
reviews.text:
Horrible staff all around.
I decided to take my pet here for a checkup on some bleeding since my usual vet was not available to see me on that day.  Dr. Salwan took x-rays and said report will be available in 24 hours.
I called repeatedly the next day and the vet never called me back.  I called again at 7PM and Jamie who answered the phone said all the vets are gone for the day and she cannot discuss my report.  Jamie was absolutely useless and not helpful and suggested that I can take my pet to the ER if I am worried.  I would have taken my pet to the ER and not waited a whole day if they had just told me how incompetent they are the day prior.

There is a reason why the review is so bad here.  Do yourself a favor and take your pet elsewhere and avoid this place.

reviews.name: athala cevallos
reviews.text: I was trying to find a reasonable place to have my dog Nita teeth clean.  I had called a Vet. Clinic in Half Moon Bay and San Mateo, I couldn't believe they wanted to charge over $1,000.00.  I found Tricity Vet on line.  I was impressed with the lady that arrange my visit, I couldn't believe how professional they were when I got there.  They are equipped with just about better than any Vet Clinic I had visit.  The cost was one forth of what I had have to pay.  Thank you Tricity, I am your customer now.

reviews.name: Ginger Greenfield
reviews.text: it's 10:53PM and i tried to call and there is no answer.. i've called twice and for someplace that's supposed to be open till 12AM.. this isn't good.. very disappointed..

reviews.name: Valencia Mills
reviews.text: Very good experience with my dog. Was kind of leary about going here due to the reviews but I'm glad we went. My dog's jaw was swollen and had a cracked toorh. She had to have surgery. Dr and staff were very informative and dr called to check on my dog after I brought her home. We still have to go back post op to remove drain from my dog's jaw but overall experience has been good this far. The only con would be the wait. I didnt see but a few people there and we had to wait awhile.

reviews.name: Lacinda Campbell-Banks
reviews.text: I love TriCity Veterinary Hospital. The employees are very professional, friendly and eager to assist you. I live in Oakland but commute all the way to Fremont because I love the Dental cleaning they perform on my dog. His teeth are always very clean I would highly recommend TriCity Veterinary Clinic to everyone.

reviews.name: Carmela Paniagua
reviews.text: My baby girl was 17 years old and her teeth were bothering her so bad.. And I was so upset at the amount they were asking. I was desperate. I came across the Tri-City Vet. I went in and spoke to the the staff and vet. I am on a fixed income and I love my girl. They examined her and she had to have 6 teeth pulled and gum cleaning. The quote they gave me was so much less than the others. They worked with me and called me right after the procedure to let me knoe how she was doing. I picked her up and she ran to me and we were so happy. She passed away a year and a half later at the age of 18.  I thank them for being so understanding and passionate with her. If and when I get another dog as I'm still in morning, this is the place to go for my pets. It helps when  you can count o a trusted vet to be there to get your baby girl or boy back to their health.. The Tri-City Veterinary Hospital is the best place to go. And there is always someone there to answer questions on the phone and in person. Us senior citizens in this economy today need places like this. It's just too bad that you can't find places like this anymore.

reviews.name: Shuai Liu
reviews.text: Don't bring your pet here. The wait is long, and the doctor never want to help you. If you love your pet this is not the place to bring them believe me.

reviews.name: Michael Tutty
reviews.text: I first brought my Pup into Tricity, May 2015. Dr. Salwan and the other staff doctors treated her with cutting-edge technology. There was  a quick diagnosis, treatment and she recovered almost immediately. I did have a small issue with the administrative staff, trying to sort paper work and appointment times, but is was remedied. A year had past and I bought Pup in for another ailment. Again, Dr. Salwan quickly diagnosed the condition and put her on a medical regiment  that brought her back to good health. He is quite knowledgeable about veterinary medicine and communicates his expertise to the pet owner professionally and with a sense of humor. The admin. staff has improved, but still needs some support. Overall Tricity provides all the needs for you pets.

reviews.name: Holli Nutter
reviews.text: Thor and I have only been to the office just once for his first check up and shots.  The office was clean, the people all friendly, and the doctor we saw was informative and really loving with my Thor.  We'll be using Tricity Veterinary Hospital as our regular vets without a doubt.

reviews.name: Linda La-Vigne
reviews.text: My female kitten needed to be spayed and she received wonderful care at Tricity Veterinary Hospital. The staff was friendly and professional and they gave me clear, post-surgery care instructions and medication.  They also reminded me of her follow-up appointment and kept me on track with her care.  The facility was clean and there were several staff members working at the desk to check patients in and out very efficiently. I highly recommend Tricity Vet!

reviews.text: Wednesday My dog check doctors. Doctor say my little cold and allergy. Say will give me prescribe medication to help my dog. Up to now is Sunday not given me .

reviews.name: Panos V
reviews.text: I used to go to Banfield but it was time to get our shitzu spade and had to look for less expensive alternatives. Tricity was much much better not only was the cost half the cost of Banfied but so much cleaner and less crowded. I love this place and would highly recommend.

reviews.name: Monica Webster
reviews.text:
this is a very good hospital, it is clean, the doctor is friendly and knowledgeable, and the staff is very nice. I would recommend this hospital.
the one problem I had is that when I scheduled my puppy for his neutering they gave me a time for my appointment when they DON'T do neuterings. they called later the next day and told me I had to reschedule for another day and time. In my opinion, the receptionist should have known this information bc its basic information for services that's their bread and butter. it was bad. I work so it just happened that I was off the next  day too.if I wasn't it would have been a hassle, and an unnecessary headache trying to take a day off, reschedule, or something. I ask one of the receptionist how much the tranquilizer pills are, later after the operation on the phone, and she gave me a range as if she didn't know. in my opinion, she should know the number bc she sells or might sell those pills all the time, bc neutering is what they do most often.
other than the receptionist not knowing very well what they should know, its a very good hospital. just ask all the right questions before going so you won't be surprised.

reviews.name: Beth Bingham
reviews.text: I had a great experience at this Veterinary Office. They have very reasonable prices which is what brought me here. The staff was knowledgable, helpful, and courteous. They did a great job cleaning my cats teeth. I would definitely recommend them.

reviews.name: JJ Mullarky
reviews.text: I have been going here for about 5 years.  I have brought 2 cats and a dog in for teeth cleaning multiple times.  The office staff is professional and my pets treated well.   The prices are very reasonable.  I have referred other pet owners to them and every one has been very happy with the service.

reviews.name: Elaine Wirsching
reviews.text: I adopted a kitty a year ago and a friend recommended Tricity Veterinary. I only had great experiences with them. They have a great staff and wonderful Vets. Priced just right.
